desc: The versatile Light Mount V-Block and Rings is a nearly-universal mounting solution for attaching a handheld light to compatible Magpul light mounts. Constructed of reinforced polymer and milspec-anodized aluminum, the Light Mount V-Block and Rings allow the user to install lights with a body diameter from .75" to 1.04" onto the MOE Scout Mount as well as a variety of M-LOK Cantilever and Offset Mounts in both Aluminum and Polymer.
